interpretation: Independent direct AnchorKernelModel applicability pilot on fixed county topology. Completed bidirectional kernels encode the whole available observed history and predict an external following-week label. Not internally causal at earlier history anchors. Not a Nikitin reproduction. No final-test, changing-topology, biological, novelty or superiority claim.
history_encoder: completed bidirectional fixed-anchor kernels over all observed history
selection: minimum chronological validation MAE in raw case units

False.geometry: C=L with all county nodes persistent, no interior reduction
False.conductance: one per unique native undirected non-self neighbor link
False.self_loop_handling: native loops cancel in D-A; source GNN has its own self/residual update
False.features: one observed count per county, standardized by training-only scaler
False.coordinates: 52 uniform weekly holds on [0,1], final observed interval midpoint anchor
False.eigensystem_reuse: one fixed normalized L eigensystem shared across holds, bag and histories
False.branch_operators: three identical plain geography operators with learned separate rates/mixtures
False.internal_context: completed bidirectional over fully observed history, not internally causal

True.geometry: C=L with all county nodes persistent, no interior reduction
True.conductance: one per unique native undirected non-self neighbor link
True.self_loop_handling: native loops cancel in D-A; source GNN has its own self/residual update
True.features: one observed count per county, standardized by training-only scaler
True.coordinates: 52 uniform weekly holds on [0,1], final observed interval midpoint anchor
True.eigensystem_reuse: one fixed normalized L eigensystem shared across holds, bag and histories
True.branch_operators: three identical plain geography operators with learned separate rates/mixtures
True.internal_context: completed bidirectional over fully observed history, not internally causal

anchor_full_d1.activity_scope: structural exclusions only, not effective degrees of freedom or empirical nonzero-gradient count

initial_model_configuration.anchor_grid: equal physical cell midpoints with cell-width masses
initial_model_configuration.source_encoder: same independent plain-boundary GNN and observed selected features
initial_model_configuration.memory_interface: queries only; references clamped independently encoded observed sources
initial_model_configuration.scale_mixture: softmax over scales, global per layer/channel, separate branch states
initial_model_configuration.normalization: matching ones query/reference source scans; no floor
initial_model_configuration.source_maps: bounded tanh q/r, shared across scales in each layer
initial_model_configuration.self_term: inclusive forward plus exclusive reverse counts once
initial_model_configuration.decoder: each layer exact readout-coordinate action from its fixed anchor sources and same gate
initial_model_configuration.limitations: finite anchor action, no continuous nonlinear integral or anchor-refinement guarantee; no performance/novelty result
